private.who: Only people in your own Google Workspace or Cloud Identity organization
private.text: An Internal app lets anyone in your Workspace org connect Gmail with no verification, no unverified-app screen and no 100-user cap.
private.quote: Your app will not be subject to the unverified app screen or the 100-user cap if it's designated as internal-only.

public.text: Any Google user needs a published, verified app: sensitive scopes need review, restricted scopes also need a yearly security assessment.

notes: Same Internal rule Google documents for all Workspace APIs; added from the Google Drive research.
